caseName: Zicherman v. Korean Air Lines Co.
caseNameFull: Zicherman, Individually and as of the Estate of Kole v. Korean Air Lines Co., Ltd. and Korean Air Lines Co., Ltd. v. Zicherman, Individually and as of the Estate of Kole

opinions.text: C. A. 2d Cir. [Certiorari granted, 514 U. S. 1062.] Motion of Philomena Dooley et al. for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of Plaintiffs’ Committee in In Re Air Crash Disaster at Lockerbie, Scotland, for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae and for additional time for oral argument denied.
